audit_status.source_base: Greek 2 Timothy text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: Compact draft reviewed for sincere trust, gift rekindled, power/love/soundness, suffering, deposit guarded.

verses.restored: Paul, apostle of Messiah Jesus through the will of the Divine, according to promise of life in Messiah Jesus,

familiar.text: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, according to the promise of life which is in Christ Jesus,

verses.restored: to Timothy, beloved child: grace, mercy, peace from Divine Father and Messiah Jesus our Lord.

familiar.text: To Timothy, my dearly beloved son: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

verses.restored: I have gratitude to the Divine, whom I serve from ancestors in a pure conscience, as I have unceasing remembrance of you in my petitions night and day,

familiar.text: I thank God, whom I serve from my forefathers with pure conscience, that without ceasing I have remembrance of thee in my prayers night and day;

verses.restored: longing to see you, remembering your tears, so that I may be filled with joy,

familiar.text: Greatly desiring to see thee, being mindful of thy tears, that I may be filled with joy;

verses.restored: having received reminder of the unhypocritical trust in you, which dwelt first in your grandmother Lois and your mother Eunice, and I have been persuaded that it is also in you.

familiar.text: When I call to remembrance the unfeigned faith that is in thee, which dwelt first in thy grandmother Lois, and thy mother Eunice; and I am persuaded that in thee also.

verses.restored: For this reason I remind you to rekindle the grace-gift of the Divine that is in you through the laying on of my hands.

familiar.text: Wherefore I put thee in remembrance that thou stir up the gift of God, which is in thee by the putting on of my hands.

verses.restored: For the Divine did not give us a spirit of fear/cowardice, but of power and love and soundness of mind.

familiar.text: For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.

verses.restored: Therefore do not be ashamed of the witness of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner, but share hardship for the good news according to the power of the Divine,

familiar.text: Be not thou therefore ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner: but be thou partaker of the afflictions of the gospel according to the power of God;

verses.restored: the One saving/healing us and calling us with a holy calling, not according to our works, but according to his own purpose and grace, given to us in Messiah Jesus before age-long times,

familiar.text: Who hath saved us, and called us with an holy calling, not according to our works, but according to his own purpose and grace, which was given us in Christ Jesus before the world began,

verses.restored: but now made manifest through the appearing of our Savior/Healer Messiah Jesus, who made death inactive and brought life and incorruptibility to light through the good news,

familiar.text: But is now made manifest by the appearing of our Saviour Jesus Christ, who hath abolished death, and hath brought life and immortality to light through the gospel:

verses.restored: for which I was appointed herald and apostle and teacher.

familiar.text: Whereunto I am appointed a preacher, and an apostle, and a teacher of the Gentiles.

verses.restored: For this reason I also suffer these things; but I am not ashamed, for I know whom I have trusted and have been persuaded that he is able to guard my deposit for that day.

familiar.text: For the which cause I also suffer these things: nevertheless I am not ashamed: for I know whom I have believed, and am persuaded that he is able to keep that which I have committed unto him against that day.

verses.restored: Hold the pattern of healthy words that you heard from me, in trust and love that are in Messiah Jesus.

familiar.text: Hold fast the form of sound words, which thou hast heard of me, in faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.

verses.restored: Guard the beautiful/good deposit through holy Spirit dwelling in us.

familiar.text: That good thing which was committed unto thee keep by the Holy Ghost which dwelleth in us.

verses.restored: You know this, that all those in Asia turned away from me, among whom are Phygelus and Hermogenes.

familiar.text: This thou knowest, that all they which are in Asia be turned away from me; of whom are Phygellus and Hermogenes.

verses.restored: May the Lord give mercy to the household of Onesiphorus, because often he refreshed me and was not ashamed of my chain,

familiar.text: The Lord give mercy unto the house of Onesiphorus; for he oft refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain:

verses.restored: but when in Rome he eagerly searched for me and found me.

familiar.text: But, when he was in Rome, he sought me out very diligently, and found me.

verses.restored: May the Lord give him to find mercy from the Lord in that day; and how many services he rendered in Ephesus, you know very well.

familiar.text: The Lord grant unto him that he may find mercy of the Lord in that day: and in how many things he ministered unto me at Ephesus, thou knowest very well.

translation_notes: The central gift language is rekindling, not striving for status.
Spirit is power, love, and soundness rather than fear/cowardice.
Guarding the deposit is communal and Spirit-enabled, not control-based.
